source_title: Where to Watch ‘O.J.’s Accomplice,’ New Docuseries Reexamining the 1994 Murders
source_excerpt:

A new two-part docuseries is taking long-standing assumptions surrounding the 1994 murders of Nicole Brown Simpson and Ron Goldman and flipping them on their head, exploring the notion that O.J. Simpson didn’t act alone.
O.J.’s Accomplice drops Nov. 1 on Peacock . While the service doesn’t offer a free trial directly, customers can claim two complimentary months of Peacock with any of DirecTV’s Signature packages , and since DirecTV offers a five-day free trial for any plan, new members can stream the two-parter at no cost during said period. Where to Stream O.J.’s Accomplice Online Free
The true crime two-parter drops on Sunday, Nov. 1 at 12:01 a.m. PT/3:01 a.m. ET. It will stream exclusively on Peacock , and while the service doesn’t offer a free trial of its own, customers can get two months of free Peacock access (thanks to a limited-time promo ) through any of DirecTV’s Signature packages , which also offer the standard five-day free trial .
Here’s exactly how to claim DirecTV’s Peacock offer: Select your preferred signature package , then opt to add “Movies Extra Pack + Peacock Premium” where it instructs you to pick your add-ons. As indicated, you’ll automatically get two months of the Movies Extra Pack + Peacock included in your subscription ( click here to see everything the add-on offers on top of Peacock ). After two months, unless cancelled at any time, DirecTV’s Movies Extra Pack + Peacock will renew monthly at the then-prevailing rate.
For another savvy streaming hack, a subscription to Peacock is available through Prime Video and unlike direct subscriptions on PeacockTV.com , Peacock on Prime Video offers a seven-day trial period for the Premium Plus plan. Following the trial, unless cancelled at any time, the subscription will continue at the standard rate.
